module.purpose: Defines the tldraw bookmark shape utility and its React renderer, including geometry, lifecycle validation, asset handling, accessibility text, interpolation, and interactive hyperlink presentation.
module.summary: This module integrates bookmark shapes with the editor's shape-util framework. It supplies default dimensions and properties, derives geometry from bookmark assets, validates URL changes, updates asset-dependent height, and renders bookmark metadata, images, favicons, descriptions, and links. Rendering adapts to Safari SVG export, handles missing or invalid favicons, and prevents ordinary pointer events from interfering with editor handling.
module.businessContext: Supports visual website bookmarks on an infinite canvas. Failures can prevent saved links, previews, metadata, or clickable navigation from rendering correctly.

detail.name: getAriaDescriptor
preconditions: The shape argument is a bookmark shape whose props may contain an assetId.
postconditions: If the linked asset has a truthy title, returns the title with common HTML entities converted, optionally followed by ', ' and the asset description.
If there is no linked asset or its title is falsy, returns undefined.
invariants: The asset description is included only when it is truthy.
The description is appended after the converted title and separated by exactly ', '.
edgeCases: When shape.props.assetId is absent or falsy, no asset is loaded and the result is undefined.
When the asset cannot be found, the result is undefined.
When the asset title is absent or falsy, the result is undefined even if a description exists.
When the asset has a truthy title and no truthy description, the result is only the converted title.
When the asset has both a truthy title and truthy description, the result contains the converted title, the exact separator ', ', and the original description.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns undefined when no linked asset or truthy asset title is available.

detail.summary: Returns an accessibility descriptor for a bookmark shape based on its linked asset title and optional description. Returns undefined when the shape has no usable asset title.

specLiterals.role: Exact separator inserted between a converted asset title and its description.

units.name: onBeforeUpdate

detail.name: onBeforeUpdate
detail.signature: onBeforeUpdate(prev: BookmarkShape, shape: BookmarkShape): BookmarkShape | undefined
preconditions: prev and shape are bookmark shapes with props.url and props.assetId fields.
postconditions: If the URL changed to an invalid value, returns a copy of shape with its URL restored to prev.props.url.
If the URL changed to a valid value, invokes bookmark asset update handling.
If the assetId changed and the URL was not rejected, returns the result of recalculating bookmark height.
If neither the URL nor assetId changed, returns undefined.
invariants: An invalid URL update never replaces the previous valid URL.
URL validation is performed only when the URL differs from the previous shape.
Asset height recalculation is performed only when assetId differs, unless an invalid URL causes an earlier return.
edgeCases: When shape.props.url differs from prev.props.url and is invalid, the method returns a new shape preserving all shape properties except restoring props.url to prev.props.url.
When shape.props.url differs and is valid, bookmark asset update handling is invoked.
When only assetId differs, bookmark height recalculation is invoked and its returned shape is returned.
When neither tracked property differs, no update is returned.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: An invalid changed URL is rejected by restoring the previous URL.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: A shape copy with the previous URL is returned.

stateMutations: May update bookmark asset state through updateBookmarkAssetOnUrlChange.
May update bookmark height-related shape state through setBookmarkHeight.
detail.summary: Validates bookmark URL changes before applying an update and preserves the previous URL when the new value is invalid. It refreshes bookmark metadata for valid URL changes and recalculates height when the asset changes.

specTests.then: It returns a shape whose props.url is "https://old.example" and does not accept the invalid URL.
It invokes bookmark asset update handling and does not return an additional shape update.
It returns the result of bookmark height recalculation.

units.name: getInterpolatedProps

detail.name: getInterpolatedProps
detail.signature: getInterpolatedProps(startShape: TLBookmarkShape, endShape: TLBookmarkShape, t: number): TLBookmarkShapeProps
preconditions: startShape and endShape provide valid TLBookmarkShape props.
t is a numeric interpolation parameter.
postconditions: The returned object contains interpolated w and h values between the corresponding startShape and endShape properties.
For properties other than w and h, the returned values come entirely from startShape when t is less than or equal to 0.5 and from endShape when t is greater than 0.5.
The input shapes are not mutated.
invariants: Width and height are calculated with linear interpolation using the same t.
The threshold for selecting non-dimensional properties is strictly greater than 0.5.
edgeCases: When t is exactly 0.5, non-dimensional properties are selected from startShape, while w and h are interpolated.
When t is greater than 0.5, non-dimensional properties are selected from endShape.
When t is less than or equal to 0.5, non-dimensional properties are selected from startShape.
Values of t outside the usual [0, 1] range are passed to the linear interpolation for w and h without validation or clamping.
detail.summary: Produces bookmark shape properties by selecting discrete properties from the start or end shape based on t while linearly interpolating width and height.

specLiterals.role: Threshold determining whether non-interpolated properties come from the start or end shape.

specTests.then: The returned width and height are the midpoint values, and the non-dimensional property is taken from startShape.

specTests.when: getInterpolatedProps is called with t greater than 0.5.
specTests.then: The returned width and height are linearly interpolated, and the non-dimensional property is taken from endShape.
The returned width and height equal startShape.props.w and startShape.props.h, and all other returned properties come from startShape.props.

detail.name: BookmarkShapeComponent
detail.signature: function BookmarkShapeComponent({ assetId, rotation, url, h, showImageContainer = true }: { assetId: TLAssetId | null; rotation: number; h: number; url: string; showImageContainer?: boolean })
preconditions: assetId is either a valid TLAssetId or null.
rotation is a numeric rotation value and h is a numeric maximum height.
url is a string suitable for bookmark and hyperlink resolution.
postconditions: Returns an HTML bookmark container whose maximum height is h.
Uses the resolved bookmark asset for title, image, description, and favicon content when available.
Renders hyperlinks targeting a new browser tab with noopener and noreferrer enabled.
If the favicon reports an error, subsequent renders use the fallback hyperlink icon instead of the favicon.
invariants: The resolved bookmark asset is obtained using the editor, assetId, and url.
The bookmark address text is derived from url using getHumanReadableAddress.
Favicon validity starts as true for the component instance and becomes false after a favicon error.
Pointer down and pointer up on bookmark links are marked handled unless the Shift key is pressed.
Image and favicon requests use referrerPolicy strict-origin-when-cross-origin.
edgeCases: When assetId is null or cannot resolve an asset, no asset metadata is shown; the image area shows a placeholder when showImageContainer is true.
When showImageContainer is false, the image container is omitted regardless of asset availability.
When the resolved asset has no image, the image container may show a placeholder, but the asset image and image hyperlink are not rendered.
When the asset has no title, the title heading link is omitted.
When the asset has a description but no image, the description paragraph is omitted.
When the favicon is absent or fails to load, a fallback hyperlink icon is rendered and the human-readable address remains visible.
When the URL is empty, hyperlinks receive an empty href while the human-readable address is still rendered.
When rendering in Safari SVG export context, the Safari export container class is applied and the rotated box shadow is omitted.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or exception handling is defined; rendering follows the available asset and URL values.

stateMutations: Mutates component-local isFaviconValid state from true to false when the favicon image fires an error event.
Marks pointer events as handled through the editor unless the Shift key is active.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Renders an HTMLContainer containing a div with bookmark container classes, optional image/placeholder content, optional title and description, and a URL link displaying either the asset favicon or a fallback icon plus the human-readable address. Links use target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer", and draggable={false}.
detail.summary: Renders a bookmark shape as an HTML card using resolved bookmark asset metadata and the supplied URL, size, and rotation. It provides image, title, description, favicon, hyperlink, and pointer-interaction behavior according to available asset data and export context.

specLiterals.role: Referrer policy applied to bookmark image and favicon requests.
Prefix used to construct the favicon image alt text from the human-readable address.
Target used by bookmark hyperlinks to open them in a new browsing context.
Security-related rel value applied to bookmark hyperlinks.

specTests.then: It renders the image container, asset image, title link, description, favicon link, and human-readable address; the description is shown because both description and image are present.

specTests.when: The favicon fires an error event.
specTests.then: The component records the favicon as invalid and renders the fallback hyperlink icon instead of the favicon on the next render.

specTests.when: The editor Shift-key state is false.
specTests.then: The event is passed to editor.markEventAsHandled; when the Shift-key state is true, it is not marked handled.

detail.name: markAsHandledOnShiftKey
preconditions: The event argument is available to pass to the editor when handling is required.
The editor input state and event-handling API are available.
postconditions: If the Shift key is not pressed, the supplied event is passed to editor.markEventAsHandled.
If the Shift key is pressed, no event-handling mutation is performed.
invariants: Event handling is conditional solely on the current Shift-key state.
edgeCases: When the Shift key is pressed, the event is not marked as handled.
When the Shift key is not pressed, including an ordinary unmodified event, the event is marked as handled.
stateMutations: May mutate the editor's handled-event state by passing the event to editor.markEventAsHandled when Shift is not pressed.
detail.summary: Marks the supplied event as handled unless the Shift key is currently pressed. Shift-modified events are left unhandled.
